Free Vaccines
Family GC, Monday morning
This one is TRUE. A named health center, a date, a clear place and nothing to sell. Calibrated trust means checking, then saying "this one is legit" and acting on it.
CONTENT_GUIDE section 3: routine childhood vaccines are available free at health centers. Section 1: calibrated trust, never "trust nothing".
Barangay Sampaguita Health Center: FREE vaccines for children every Wednesday, 8 to 11 AM. Bring the vaccine card. Walk-ins welcome. Please share with the moms! 🙏
My grandchild is due for her shots! Should we go on Wednesday?
Hmm, "free" and "please share"... sounds like a hoax to me.
Is this a hoax or the real thing? What do you do?
